title: 第9章 你把婚离了第10章 着急见公婆
lines: 第9章你把婚离了
无声，却让她一直压抑的情绪，得到前所未有的解放，就算是一个人独处的时候，她都选择让自己变得更加坚强。
但是，这一刻，情绪不受控制，好似只有这样，才能宣泄她心里的苦闷。
未婚夫与妹妹的背叛，爸妈从小的不喜爱，让她一度觉得自己好似被遗弃的那一个。
权天睿自然也是感受到胸前的温热，没有说什么，但是搂着她的手，却紧了几分。
或许是哭累了，加上昨夜她也确实是累坏了，今天由因为夏明华的电话，让她心情不好，所以一股脑的埋入了工作之中，根本没有半分让自己喘息的机会。
这会儿，竟然在权天睿的怀里沉沉的睡着了过去。
看着在自己怀里睡着的小女人，权天睿眼神温柔缱绻。
“李锦，将所有工作提前，三天后全部空出来。”
正在开车的李锦也是有些意外，一向以工作为重的Boss居然打算要休息？简直天上下红雨嘛！
尽管内心吐槽，但是嘴上还得应承。
“好的，Boss。”
一连三天，夏天都没有见到权天睿，其实权天睿也回来的，只是回来的太晚，回来的时候夏天已经睡着了，早上醒来的时候已经走了。
本来夏天还打算跟他提一提离婚的事情的，毕竟那天因为夏青荷的出现打乱了她原本要说的话，结果一连三天都没有见到人。
不过正好她这几天都在赶稿子，所以倒也没有觉得什么，反正她就不相信了，这个男人打算消失一辈子了。
只是显然有人嫌弃她的心情太悠闲，夏天刚刚吃过午饭，打算进书房去把自己剩下来的一点点稿子给画完，然后交给编辑完工的。
没有想到，夏明华的电话来了。
看到来电显示，夏天很不想接电话，按掉一次又一次，但是那电话就是契而不舍的响起来。
夏天被扰的烦了，接起电话，直接朝夏明华吼去。
“你有完没完？你不烦我还烦。”
夏天用脚趾头都能猜到夏明华打电话的目的，估计也是听夏青荷说起她结婚了，这会儿打电话来问个明白的吧！
“夏天，有你这么跟你爸爸说话的吗？”
“抱歉，我爸爸死了，你是哪位？”夏天干脆扔掉手中的画笔，将身子斜靠在座椅上。
“你……”显然夏明华被夏天气得不轻。
对于夏明华，夏天是真的一点也亲不起来，从小他对自己出了打骂就再无其他。
说是夏家大小姐，可是过得连一条狗都不如。
她从小到大，都只有吃剩饭的份儿，就连衣服都是穿夏青荷不穿的，所以她的衣服从来就没有合身过，一度成为了上流圈子的一个笑话。
只是这些她都不在意，最在意的却是三年前。
她跟陆翊恋爱了两年，准备订婚，却没有想到被夏青荷给撬了墙角，身为她爸的夏明华，非但没有责骂夏青荷，反倒是对她又打又骂。
她永远记得，他说：“你自己没用，连个男人都留不住，还有什么脸面哭诉？”
“陆翊是以后陆氏集团的继承人，青荷嫁过去，也总比这个养不家的白眼狼好。”
这些话，尤记在耳！
对于他们，早已经死心了。
“夏明华，有事说事，没事我就挂了，忙得很。”
content_en:
Chapter 9 You divorced
The silence allowed her suppressed emotions to be liberated like never before. Even when she was alone, she chose to become stronger.
However, at this moment, her emotions were out of control, as if this was the only way to vent her inner anguish.
The betrayal of her fiancé and her sister, and her parents' dislike since she was a child, made her feel like the abandoned one.
Quan Tianrui naturally felt the warmth on his chest. He didn't say anything, but his arms around her became a little tighter.
Maybe she was tired from crying, and she was really exhausted last night. Today, because of Xia Minghua's call, she was in a bad mood, so she was immersed in work, without any chance to breathe.
At this moment, he fell asleep deeply in Quan Tianrui's arms.
Looking at the little woman sleeping in his arms, Quan Tianrui's eyes were gentle and caring.
"Li Jin, advance all the work and make it available in three days."
Li Jin, who was driving, was also a little surprised. Boss, who always puts work first, actually planned to take a rest? It’s like it’s raining red from the sky!
Although I complained in my heart, I still had to agree with my mouth.
"Okay, Boss."
For three days in a row, Xia Tian didn't see Quan Tianrui. In fact, Quan Tianrui also came back, but he came back too late. When he came back, Xia Tian had already fallen asleep, and when he woke up in the morning, he had already left.
Originally, Xia Tian planned to mention the divorce to him. After all, Xia Qinghe's appearance disrupted what she was going to say that day, and she didn't see anyone for three days in a row.
But she happened to be working on a manuscript these days, so she didn't feel anything. Anyway, she didn't believe it. This man planned to disappear for the rest of his life.
But it was obvious that some people thought her mood was too leisurely. Xia Tian had just had lunch and planned to go into the study to finish the remaining manuscripts and then hand them over to the editor for completion.
Unexpectedly, Xia Minghua's call came.
Seeing the caller ID, Xia Tian didn't want to answer the phone and pressed it again and again, but the phone kept ringing.
Xia Tian was annoyed by being disturbed. He picked up the phone and yelled directly at Xia Minghua.
"Are you done yet? I'm still annoyed if you don't bother me."
Xia Tian could guess the purpose of Xia Minghua's call with her toes. She probably heard Xia Qinghe talk about her getting married, so she should call now to find out!
"Xia Tian, have you ever talked to your father like this?"
"Sorry, my father is dead. Who are you?" Xia Tian simply threw away the paintbrush in his hand and leaned on the seat.
"You..." Xia Minghua was obviously very angry with Xia Tian.
For Xia Minghua, Xia Tian really couldn't get close to him at all. He had never beaten or scolded him since he was a child.
She is said to be the eldest lady of the Xia family, but her life is worse than that of a dog.
She had only had leftovers to eat since she was a child, and she even wore clothes that Xia Qinghe didn't wear, so her clothes never fit well, and she once became a joke in the upper class circles.
It's just that she doesn't care about any of this. What she cares about most is three years ago.
She had been in love with Lu Yi for two years and was about to get engaged, but she didn't expect that Xia Qinghe would force her into a corner. As her father, Xia Minghua, instead of scolding Xia Qinghe, he beat and scolded her.
She will always remember what he said: "You are useless. You can't even keep a man, so why do you have the face to cry?"
"Lu Yi is the heir to the Lu Group in the future. Qing He is better off marrying him than this white-eyed wolf who can't support the family."
Keep these words in mind!
I have already given up on them.
"Xia Minghua, if you have something to say, I'll hang up if nothing else happens. I'm very busy."
